title: AMOC eval: the pixels the model rolls forward
source: earth / E-022 · ml/rollout_spatial.py over the family3_X.npy tensor
citation: Every pixel this experiment advances one month at a time. The stage-2 head predicts each pixel's next embedding; the E-022 evaluator rolls ALL window ocean pixels (a stencil head reads its neighbours, so a region roll would need a growing halo), then scores an AMOC corridor derived from the data itself: mean current speed over training months at or above the 75th percentile, dilated 2 cells, unioned with the RAPID 26.5°N section. Not hand-drawn, and written by the scoring code.
